# Quantum Routing Bandwidth

> Matched interaction-time laws for exchanging unknown registers through a bounded qubit bus, with reusable clean or independently mixed helpers.

## Story and scientific results

- [Scientific account](science/README.md): Physical question, model, principal result, and connected reading route.
- [Theorem map](science/theorem-map.md): Exact quantifiers, proof dependencies, and canonical statement locations.
- [Information flow](science/entropy-flow.md): Conditional variance, singular-state support, and weighted-interface ensemble bounds.
- [Exact helper laws](science/bandwidth.md): Physical entropy budget and spectator-preserving coherent constructions.
- [Imperfect preparation](science/mixed-helpers.md): Fixed-error iid law, joint/reference restoration, full-rank zero-error boundary, and correlated-state counterexample.
- [Accuracy and resources](science/accuracy-and-resources.md): Finite certificates against the full comparator class, synchronized lists, fresh-payload reuse, and alternate contact budgets.
- [Finite control](science/control-models.md): An explicit bounded-strength compiler, separate from the free-internal-control theorem.
- [Physical interpretation](science/interpretation.md): How contact geometry, unknown data, and reusable preparation determine the operational comparison.

## Study

- [Learning route](learning/README.md): Common foundations-to-result route.
- [Watrous bridge](learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md): The sole educational anchor, relevant sections, errata, and normalization conventions.
- [Thirty milestones](learning/MILESTONES.md): Stable project-defined M01–M30, with 14 background and 16 narrative targets, dependencies, conceptual connections, and sources.
- [Worked examples](learning/WORKED_EXAMPLES.md): Reference-assisted swap, three-qubit coherent amplification, and preparation concentration.

## Sources and reproduction

- [Related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md): Established ingredients and model-level literature comparisons.
- [Bibliography](references/references.bib): Source metadata, including W18 for the anchor.
- [Verification](verification/README.md): Commands, suite coverage, expected outputs, and their evidence limits.
- [Executed summary](verification/results/verification.json): Scientific source and output hashes from an executed run.
- [Exact certificates](verification/results/scientific-closure.json): Finite quantitative and reuse checks.
- [Research guidance](AGENTS.md): Authorized scope, scientific invariants, presentation, and checks.

Essential distinctions: both interfaces are bounded; the main budget is per contact; internal unitaries are free only in the interaction-time theorem. Unknown helpers and fixed inserted helper purifications are different input promises. Exact helper marginal return is not exact joint/reference restoration in the mixed case. The entropy-budget converse does not establish arbitrary-state entropy-only saturation. The finite-strength compiler is not a universal no-go theorem. Proofs establish general claims; finite verification is not independent endorsement or hardware validation.

This guide maps common scientific and study questions to public authoritative files. It contains no personal assessment contract or learner record and requires no private source for the shared learning route. It aids retrieval without guaranteeing indexing.
